fullPassage: A detailed anthropological study of daily scientific practice in the Salk Institute laboratory in La Jolla, California shows how difficult it is to assign credit and dates. Bruno Latour describes how scientists arrived at the elucidation of TRF (thyrotropin-releasing factor), a hormone that is secreted by the brain. He says that his observations led him to "the conviction that a body of practices widely regarded by outsiders as well organized, logical, and coherent, in fact consists of a disordered array of observations with which scientists struggle to produce order." The final consensus formulation of TRF (i.e., when it became a scientific "fact") emerged some time between January 1968 and January 1970. Half of the Nobel Prize in Medicine for 1977 for this discovery was shared between the Salk group and another competing group in New Orleans (the other half went to Rosalind Yalow for the techniques she developed that were used in these studies), but each of these two competing groups strongly felt that they deserved sole credit and that the other did not deserve even a share of the award.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

A detailed anthropological study of daily scientific practice in the Salk Institute laboratory in La Jolla, California shows how difficult it is to assign credit and dates.

(A) The final consensus formulation of TRF emerged some time between January 1968 and January 1970. Half of the Nobel Prize in Medicine for 1977 for this discovery was shared between the Salk group and another competing group in New Orleans, but each group strongly felt that they deserved sole credit.

(B) Bruno Latour describes how scientists arrived at the elucidation of TRF (thyrotropin-releasing factor), a hormone that is secreted by the brain.

(C) He says that his observations led him to the conviction that scientific practices, widely regarded by outsiders as well organized, in fact consist of a disordered array of observations with which scientists struggle to produce order.

det.korean: 순서: (B) TRF 소개 → (C) 관찰 결론 → (A) 결과/공로 다툼
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): (A)의 'The final consensus formulation of TRF'는 TRF가 먼저 소개되어야 함

❌ ② (A)-(C)-(B): (A)가 먼저 오면 TRF 소개 없이 결론부터 나옴

✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): (B) 'Bruno Latour describes how scientists arrived at TRF 규명' → (C) 'He says(=Latour)의 관찰 결론: 외부 인식 vs 실제' → (A) '최종 합의 등장 + 노벨상 공로 다툼' — 인물 소개→관찰→결과 순서 ← 정답

❌ ④ (C)-(B)-(A): (C)의 'He'가 먼저 오면 지시 대상(Latour) 없음
det.tip: 연결 단서: (B) Bruno Latour → (C) He says(=Latour) → (A) The final(결론). 인물→관찰→결과
